title: Google Business Profile Automation: Complete Guide for 2026

facts.fact: The vendor states it will set up the customer's Google Business Profile automation at no extra cost.
facts.quote: We’ll set it up for you at no extra cost.

facts.fact: The guide is dated August 13, 2026 and is written by Dammy.
The page states the guide takes 21 minutes to read.
A connected Google Business Profile exposes five tabs: Performance, Reviews, Request reviews, Posts and Business info.
facts.quote: A connected Google Business Profile gives you five tabs and no more: Performance, Reviews, Request reviews, Posts and Business info.

facts.fact: Every Reputation tab shows sample data (made-up reviews, names and numbers) before a Google Business Profile is connected.
facts.quote: Every Reputation tab works before a profile is attached, and what it shows is sample data: made-up reviews, made-up names, made-up numbers

facts.fact: Questions and answers on a Google listing are not managed through the Google Business Profile tabs and cannot be automated from outside.
facts.quote: Questions and answers on your listing are not managed here.

facts.fact: A Google Business Profile offers no messaging channel; a review is the only conversation Google provides, and the customer cannot reply to the business's reply.
facts.quote: A review is the only conversation Google gives you here, and the customer cannot reply to your reply.

facts.fact: Photos can only reach a Google listing by attaching them to a post (an update, an offer or an event), not through a photo manager.
facts.quote: You can attach one to an update, an offer or an event.

facts.fact: The vendor's Nigeria site shows prices in naira.
facts.quote: See prices in naira on DMly Nigeria.

facts.fact: The vendor's South Africa site shows prices in rand.
facts.quote: See DMly South Africa, with prices shown in rand.
